title: Patch: watch a friend's Duos game like a 1v1 game

**Issue #2881 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #2881: Patch: watch a friend's Duos game like a 1v1 game
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

Today you can watch a friend's live 1v1 match from their side, a few seconds behind. You cannot watch a friend's co-op game at all. After this change, watching works for co-op too: you see your friend's team view on the same delay, and the game plays on exactly as before.

## Why

- The spec explicitly excludes co-op from watching (`spec/09-architecture.md` §9.5: "A co-op game cannot be watched (§13)"), while all the machinery watching needs already exists for Duos: `duos_view_for`, the co-op board (`apps/web/src/duos/DuosBoard.tsx`), and the friend/presence/challenge plumbing.
- Co-op is the social mode (§13, `/together`); not being able to spectate it is the gap players will notice first, and pings already being teammate-only and unlogged (B39, `crates/server/src/duos/actor.rs`) shows the design knows how to keep watchers out of the game.
- This is new: issue #2739 is about watching an opponent Discover in 1v1 (different feature), and no rejected suggestion covers spectating.

## Proposal

- Mirror the 1v1 watch contract for one co-op seat: friend-only, at most `SPECTATORS_PER_MATCH` watchers, each view `SPECTATE_DELAY_MS` behind, no legal actions, watcher frames never reach the reducer, count changes announced, socket closed once the result view is sent (R1107000, R1103000, R2615000).
- The watcher sees the friend's seat view (own plus what the team shares, §13.6), never the AI team's hidden state and never pings; a finished co-op game stays replay-only via the existing co-op replay file (R1242000).
- Spec change: lift the §9.5 exclusion with a short paragraph naming the delay, the cap and whose view a watcher gets.

## Where it lands

- `spec/09-architecture.md` §9.5 and §13 (the exclusion and the watch contract); `crates/server/src/duos/` (watch socket beside `actor.rs`); `apps/web/src/duos/` (watch route on `DuosBoard.tsx`); engine `duos_view_for` reused, not changed.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A friend can watch a live co-op game from the friend's seat view, delayed, with no actions offered and nothing they do affecting the game.
- [ ] A non-friend, a full game, and a blocked pair are refused exactly like 1v1 watch; ending the friendship or blocking mid-watch drops the watcher.
- [ ] Watch count changes reach both human seats; the socket closes after the result view.
- [ ] The AI team's hidden hands/decks are unreachable from watch traffic (a test holds a watcher to the friend's `duos_view_for` bytes).

## Size and risks

Medium-large: server plus client plus spec; `difficulty:hard` (design across crates). Main risk is leaking hidden co-op state through a new socket; mitigate by sending only already-filtered `duos_view_for` frames, as 1v1 watch does with `view_for`.

---

## Steps

1. Spec first. In `spec/09-architecture.md` §9.5, replace "A co-op game cannot be watched ([[§13]])." by extending the Watching paragraph: one co-op seat watched like 1v1 (friend-only, `SPECTATORS_PER_MATCH`, `SPECTATE_DELAY_MS`, friend's seat `duos_view_for`, no pings, close after result per [[R1107000]]). In `spec/13-duos.md`, remove "watching a Duos game" from the §13 intro out-of-scope list and add one paragraph (§13.6 end): watcher gets the friend's seat view only, never AI hidden state or pings; finished games replay-only via [[R1242000]].
2. `crates/server/src/duos/watch.rs` (new, copy `social/watch.rs` structure): hello `{"type":"hello","matchId","friendId"}`; `serve` authenticates via `authenticate_upgrade` with the new path, calls `may_watch`, attaches through `duos::registry`, rechecks after attach and revokes on race. `watchable_in`: `are_friends` (covers blocks) + `duos_matches_get` live (`ended_at` none) + friend is a1/a2 + watcher is neither. Refusals: one `forbidden` frame + 4403 (4401 pre-sign-in, 4429 budget, 1011 fault), text `WATCH_NOT_ALLOWED` (import from `actor::match_actor` as `social/watch.rs` does).
3. `crates/server/src/duos/actor.rs`: add `DuosSpectate` (per-`HUMAN_SEATS` record queues of encoded `DuosServerMessage::View` with `legal: vec![]`, `jlore_capped: false`, `economy: None`, clock unset since `engine::view` leaves it so) + `DuosWatcher { id, profile_id, home: DuosSeat, socket, sent, guard: SeatGuard }`. Copy `attach_watcher`/`answer_watcher_hello`/`note_watcher_junk`/`detach_watcher`/`spectate_flush`/`spectate_let_go_finished` from `match_actor.rs` (~lines 2396–2874), replacing `PlayerId`/`PLAYERS` with `DuosSeat`/`HUMAN_SEATS`, reusing `SPECTATE_DELAY_MS`, `SPECTATORS_PER_MATCH`, `WATCH_HELLO_INTERVAL_MS`, `MALFORMED_FRAMES_PER_WINDOW`, `watchers_frame`, `after`. Count frames go raw to both human seats (add `send_text_to_seat`; also send current count in `push_seat`). Call `spectate_record_in` in `after_change`, in `on_terminal` (record, flush, close finished with `CLOSE_NORMAL`/"the match is over", push counts), once in `on_arm` for a live rebuilt actor, and in `create_duos_actor` for the opening state. `halt` closes watcher sockets (`CLOSE_GOING_AWAY`, `closed = true`).
4. `crates/server/src/duos/registry.rs`: `attach_watcher(app, match_id, friend_id, watcher_id, socket)` (resolve actor via `get`/`actor_for` with the same pre-fold seat check `attach` uses; `seat_of(friend_id)`; map full/closed to refusal), `watcher_count`, `revoke_watchers`. `duos/mod.rs`: add `pub mod watch;`.
5. `crates/server/src/actor/ws_server.rs` + `app.rs`: `WS_DUOS_WATCH_PATH`, `handle_duos_watch` mirroring `handle_watch` (origin, address slot, subprotocol, `HelloGate`, `pump`), route it in `app.rs` beside the `WATCH_PATH` route.
6. Store + presence: add `presence_watchable_duos(viewer, ids)` to `db/store.rs`, `db/fake.rs`, `db/pg.rs` (1v1 `presence_watchable` logic over `duos_matches` a1/a2 + friendships/blocks). `presence.rs`: `Standing { ..., duos: bool }`; duos branch sets `duos: true`, `watchable = set.contains && watcher_count < SPECTATORS_PER_MATCH`. `friends.rs`: `Friend.duos` (camelCase) via `Friend::of`.
7. Revocation: `duos::watch::revoke_between` via registry; call it alongside the 1v1 one in `remove_friend`, `post_block` (`friends.rs`), and account delete (`api/auth.rs`).
8. Web: `navigate.ts` (`duosWatch: id => "/watch-duos/" + id`, `duosWatchIdOf`), `chunks.tsx` (`duosWatch` → `../duos/DuosWatchRoute.tsx`, `chunkAt`, `ENGINE_CHUNKS`), `main.tsx` branch, `watchLink.ts` (`duosWatchLink`), `social.ts` (`Friend.duos`), `FriendRows.tsx` (duos branch). `socket.ts`: parse `{"type":"watchers","count"}` into `snapshot.watchers` (init `null`); `DuosRoute.tsx`: show it in the status line when non-null.
9. `DuosWatchRoute.tsx` (new, copy `WatchRoute.tsx` + `DuosReplay.tsx:181`'s board element): hello `{type:"hello",matchId,friendId}` on `/ws/duos-watch`; render `<DuosBoard view legal={NOTHING} onAction={ignore} pings={NO_PINGS} onPing={ignore} jloreCapped={false} replay />`; send nothing else; wake probe + `WATCH_RECONNECT_MS`/`WATCH_RECONNECT_ATTEMPTS` from `together/config.ts`; refused/closed panels in `WatchRoute.tsx`'s words.

## Tests

- `crates/server/tests/actor/duos_watch.rs` (new; reuse `duos.rs`'s `Served`/`serve`/`WsClient`, `watch.rs`'s paused-clock + delay pattern, `support::store::befriend`, friends tests' `duos_match` helper): `friend_gets_delayed_seat_view_with_no_legal` (advance past `SPECTATE_DELAY_MS`, watcher bytes equal the friend seat's `actor.view_for` encoded with `legal: []`); `stranger_full_and_blocked_are_refused` (non-friend, `SPECTATORS_PER_MATCH` fill, block → `forbidden` + close); `unfriend_or_block_mid_watch_drops_the_watcher` (socket gets `forbidden`, both seats get new counts); `watchers_count_reaches_both_seats_and_socket_closes_after_result` (close `CLOSE_NORMAL` only after the final view); `watch_traffic_holds_watcher_to_friend_duos_view_for` (byte equality + teammate ping never arrives + no AI hand); `watcher_frames_never_reach_the_reducer` (action/ping on watcher socket change no log row/hash). Run `cargo test -p jackioh-server --test server actor::duos_watch`.
- `crates/server/tests/api/friends.rs`: rename `b47_a_friend_in_a_duos_match_is_in_match_naming_it_and_not_watchable` to `..._and_watchable`, assert `watchable: true` + `duos: true`. `cargo test -p jackioh-server --test server api::friends`.
- `crates/server/tests/store/contract.rs`: duos-watchable case next to the `presence_watchable` block. `cargo test -p jackioh-server --test server_store`.
- `crates/server/tests/sql/22_social.sql` + `sh crates/server/tests/sql/run.sh` if it covers `presence_watchable`.
- `apps/web/src/duos/DuosWatchRoute.test.tsx` (new): delayed friend view renders read-only (no action offered); refused socket shows can't-watch panel; reconnect bounds. `apps/web/src/duos/socket.test.ts`: `it("parses the watchers count")`. Run `pnpm --dir apps/web test <file>` for each touched file.
- Checks: `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy -p jackioh-server --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo jackioh spec check`, `test -z "$(git status --porcelain -- apps/web/src/wire)"`.

## Done when

- [ ] Friend watches live co-op from friend's delayed seat view, nothing offered, game unaffected.
- [ ] Non-friend, full game, blocked pair refused like 1v1; mid-watch unfriend/block/account-delete drops the watcher.
- [ ] Both human seats get count changes; socket closes after the result view.
- [ ] Watcher bytes held to friend's `duos_view_for`; no AI hidden state, no pings.
- [ ] Presence `watchable`/`duos` true for a watchable co-op friend; exclusion specs lifted, no new R-number.
- [ ] All named tests + checks above pass.

## Risks

- Hidden-state leak through the new socket: only pre-filtered `engine::view` frames are recorded; byte-equality test pins it. Pings only address teammate seat sockets, never watchers.
- Count frames are raw `watchers_frame` text on duos sockets (not a `DuosServerMessage` variant): no engine/wire change, but `parseDuosFrame` must learn it or seats ignore it silently.
- Watchers must not pin actors: `has_open_socket` unchanged (seats only); finished actors close watchers at the result then reap.
- `Friend` gains `duos`: match ids are UUIDs in both modes so the client cannot branch without it; old clients ignore the field.

## Open questions

None.

Refusals: one `forbidden` frame + 4403 (4401 pre-sign-in, 4429 budget, 1011 fault), text `WATCH_NOT_ALLOWED` (import from `actor::match_actor` as `social/watch.rs` does).
3. `crates/server/src/duos/actor.rs`: add `DuosSpectate` (per-`HUMAN_SEATS` record queues of encoded `DuosServerMessage::View` with `legal: vec![]`, `jlore_capped: false`, `economy: None`, clock unset since `engine::view` leaves it so) + `DuosWatcher { id, profile_id, home: DuosSeat, socket, sent, guard: SeatGuard }`. Copy `attach_watcher`/`answer_watcher_hello`/`note_watcher_junk`/`detach_watcher`/`spectate_flush`/`spectate_let_go_finished` from `match_actor.rs` (~lines 2396–2874), replacing `PlayerId`/`PLAYERS` with `DuosSeat`/`HUMAN_SEATS`, reusing `SPECTATE_DELAY_MS`, `SPECTATORS_PER_MATCH`, `WATCH_HELLO_INTERVAL_MS`, `MALFORMED_FRAMES_PER_WINDOW`, `watchers_frame`, `after`. Count frames go raw to both human seats (add `send_text_to_seat`; also send current count in `push_seat`). Call `spectate_record_in` in `after_change`, in `on_terminal` (record, flush, close finished with `CLOSE_NORMAL`/"the match is over", push counts), once in `on_arm` for a live rebuilt actor, and in `create_duos_actor` for the opening state. `halt` closes watcher sockets (`CLOSE_GOING_AWAY`, `closed = true`).
4. `crates/server/src/duos/registry.rs`: `attach_watcher(app, match_id, friend_id, watcher_id, socket)` (resolve actor via `get`/`actor_for` with the same pre-fold seat check `attach` uses; `seat_of(friend_id)`; map full/closed to refusal), `watcher_count`, `revoke_watchers`. `duos/mod.rs`: add `pub mod watch;`.
5. `crates/server/src/actor/ws_server.rs` + `app.rs`: `WS_DUOS_WATCH_PATH`, `handle_duos_watch` mirroring `handle_watch` (origin, address slot, subprotocol, `HelloGate`, `pump`), route it in `app.rs` beside the `WATCH_PATH` route.

Store + presence: add `presence_watchable_duos(viewer, ids)` to `db/store.rs`, `db/fake.rs`, `db/pg.rs` (1v1 `presence_watchable` logic over `duos_matches` a1/a2 + friendships/blocks). `presence.rs`: `Standing { ..., duos: bool }`; duos branch sets `duos: true`, `watchable = set.contains && watcher_count < SPECTATORS_PER_MATCH`. `friends.rs`: `Friend.duos` (camelCase) via `Friend::of`.
7. Revocation: `duos::watch::revoke_between` via registry; call it alongside the 1v1 one in `remove_friend`, `post_block` (`friends.rs`), and account delete (`api/auth.rs`).
8. Web: `navigate.ts` (`duosWatch: id => "/watch-duos/" + id`, `duosWatchIdOf`), `chunks.tsx` (`duosWatch` → `../duos/DuosWatchRoute.tsx`, `chunkAt`, `ENGINE_CHUNKS`), `main.tsx` branch, `watchLink.ts` (`duosWatchLink`), `social.ts` (`Friend.duos`), `FriendRows.tsx` (duos branch). `socket.ts`: parse `{"type":"watchers","count"}` into `snapshot.watchers` (init `null`); `DuosRoute.tsx`: show it in the status line when non-null.
9. `DuosWatchRoute.tsx` (new, copy `WatchRoute.tsx` + `DuosReplay.tsx:181`'s board element): hello `{type:"hello",matchId,friendId}` on `/ws/duos-watch`; render `<DuosBoard view legal={NOTHING} onAction={ignore} pings={NO_PINGS} onPing={ignore} jloreCapped={false} replay />`; send nothing else; wake probe + `WATCH_RECONNECT_MS`/`WATCH_RECONNECT_ATTEMPTS` from `together/config.ts`; refused/closed panels in `WatchRoute.tsx`'s words.
